Pale, goblin-size mold being with a rough-featured face, two lanky arms, and a long tendril grown from its back.

AC 13, HP 25, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8) and 1 tendril +4 (1d8 + spores), MV near, S +3, D +3, C +3, I +1, W +3, Ch +1, AL N, LV 5

Spores. Moldwretch forms symbiosis with other molds nearby, spreading their spores with its attack. Brown. Moldwretch is immune to fire, +1d6 damage. Russet. CON 12+ or 1d4 CON damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check once per day; ends on success. Die at 0 CON and spawn vegepygmy. Yellow. CON 12+ or 1 CON damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check once per round; ends on success.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
